messages:
Maya: Heads-up — after pulling latest node SDK into the sampleapp the request IDs are missing from debug logs when LOG_LEVEL=verbose. Repro on macbook. :eyes:
Sam: I can repro locally too. Only happens when OpenTelemetry is enabled; simple non-otel run keeps the x-request-id in logs.
Irene: Which SDK version? I thought we fixed the redact-on-verbose quirk last week.
Maya: using @redwood/sdk-node v0.12.4 (recent). I bisected to the otel hook change that introduced async header normalization.
Sam: Repro snippet (minimal):
```js
// order matters here
app.use(require('redwood-telemetry').otelHook())
app.use(require('redwood-telemetry').logHook())
```
Sam: When otelHook runs first, our logHook sometimes logs before the request-id is copied into context on retries. On simple requests it's fine. With retry middleware you see blank reqid fields.
Maya: Also observed that with REDACT_SENSITIVE=true the header key `x-request-id` is sometimes fully removed from the request object (not just masked) during the retry flow. That's new.
Irene: Could be a race between otel async init and our sync logger middleware. Are we awaiting the otel init anywhere?
Ajay: Looking at the hook code — otelHook sets context async: `getContext().then(c => setReqIdFromHeaders(c))` while logHook is sync and reads `req.ctx.reqId`. If logHook runs before promise settles we log empty.
Maya: Repro steps I used: clone sampleapp, `LOG_LEVEL=verbose REDACT_SENSITIVE=true OTEL_ENABLED=1 npm start`, then `for i in {1..5}; do curl -s -X POST http://localhost:3000/api/text -d '{"q":"x"}' -H 'Content-Type: application/json'; done` — check stdout.
Sam: Quick local workaround: swap middleware order so logHook runs after otelHook's async path completes by inserting a tiny await: in app startup `await telemetry.initialize()` then mount logHook.
Ajay: I pushed a tiny PR with two options: 1) make otelHook initialize synchronously at bootstrap, or 2) make logHook read from fallback header `req.headers['x-request-id']` if ctx missing. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk-node/pull/199 :thumbsup:
Irene: Both fixes sound reasonable; prefer making otel init sync-ish so we don't rely on header fallback. But need to be careful about startup blocking for Private deployments.
Maya: Created a short test case that fails: attached snippet (I pasted it into the ticket). Repro is fast and deterministic on my laptop.
telemetry-bot: New issue created: TW-5412 — "node sdk: reqid disappears when OTEL + verbose logs + retries" — linked to PR #199.
devdeploy: FYI, can we gate the hosted samples deployment? want to avoid breaking onboarding for new users.
Ajay: I'll add a feature flag and a migration note in changelog. If CI passes we'll merge behind flag and flip after smoke tests.
Sam: Sounds good. Thanks for the quick triage everyone.
Maya: Thanks — I'll add the failing run log to the ticket and note which sampleapp branch we used. :coffee:
